ex.en: Please attach your college transcript to the application.
ex.zh: 申請時請附上大學成績單。

ex.en: My transcript shows all the courses I took.
ex.zh: 我的成績單列出了我修過的所有課。

transcript.en: an official record of the classes a student has taken and the marks received

ex.en: You can read the full transcript of the interview online.
ex.zh: 你可以在網路上看到這段訪談的完整逐字稿。

ex.en: The video comes with a transcript for learners.
ex.zh: 這部影片附有給學習者的逐字稿。

transcript.en: a written copy of exactly what was said in a talk, interview or recording

ex.en: The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
ex.zh: 那位旅人看到遠方的燈光，高興極了。

ex.en: Business travelers often prefer hotels near the airport.
ex.zh: 商務旅客通常比較喜歡機場附近的飯店。

ex.en: The app gives travelers real-time flight updates.
ex.zh: 這個 App 為旅客提供即時航班資訊。

traveler.en: a person who is making a trip, especially a long one

ex.en: I'd like to cash a travelers' check.
ex.zh: 我想兌換旅行支票。

ex.en: May I pay with a travelers' check?
ex.zh: 我可以用旅行支票付款嗎？

traveler.en: a printed check that can be exchanged for money abroad and is safe if lost

ex.en: My personal trainer helps me lose weight.
ex.zh: 我的私人教練幫我減重。

ex.en: The company hired a trainer to teach sales skills.
ex.zh: 公司請了一位講師來教銷售技巧。

trainer.en: a person who teaches or coaches people to improve their fitness or skills

ex.en: I know that Tom is a horse trainer.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆是馴馬師。

ex.en: Tom is a dolphin trainer.
ex.zh: 湯姆是海豚訓練師。

ex.en: The lion followed the trainer's commands.
ex.zh: 獅子聽從馴獸師的指令。

trainer.en: a person who teaches animals to obey commands or perform tasks

ex.en: The new trainees start work on Monday.
ex.zh: 新進受訓人員星期一開始上班。

ex.en: She joined the bank as a management trainee.
ex.zh: 她以儲備幹部的身分進入銀行。

trainee.en: a person who is learning how to do a job

ex.en: Mr Yamaha filled the big tray in his living room with walnuts.
ex.zh: 山葉先生在客廳的大托盤裡裝滿了核桃。

ex.en: The waiter carried the drinks on a tray.
ex.zh: 服務生用托盤端著飲料。

ex.en: Please return your tray to the counter after lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐後請把餐盤放回櫃台。

tray.en: a flat object with raised edges, used for carrying food and drinks

ex.en: The printer's paper tray is empty.
ex.zh: 印表機的紙匣沒紙了。

ex.en: Put the signed documents in the tray on my desk.
ex.zh: 把簽好的文件放在我桌上的文件盤裡。

tray.en: a flat open container for holding papers on a desk or in a machine

ex.en: We want natural-sounding translations, not word-for-word direct translations.
ex.zh: 我們要的是自然的翻譯，不是逐字直譯。

ex.en: The translation is quite true to the original.
ex.zh: 這份翻譯相當忠於原文。

ex.en: Are you sure you don't use machine translations?
ex.zh: 你確定你沒用機器翻譯？

translation.en: the act of changing words from one language into another, or the text that results

ex.en: My uncle had me act as a translator.
ex.zh: 我叔叔請我擔任翻譯。

ex.en: Thanks to all the translators!
ex.zh: 感謝所有的翻譯人員！

ex.en: I'm a translator.
ex.zh: 我是翻譯。

translator.en: a person whose job is to change written or spoken words into another language

ex.en: Data transmission is much faster with fiber optics.
ex.zh: 使用光纖傳輸資料快很多。

ex.en: Washing your hands helps prevent the transmission of disease.
ex.zh: 洗手有助於預防疾病傳播。

transmission.en: the act of sending signals, information or disease from one place or person to another

ex.en: Can you drive a manual transmission?
ex.zh: 你會開手排車嗎？

ex.en: The car needs a new transmission.
ex.zh: 這輛車需要換新的變速箱。

transmission.en: the part of a car that sends power from the engine to the wheels

ex.en: The data is transmitted over the internet.
ex.zh: 資料是透過網路傳送的。

ex.en: The disease is transmitted by mosquitoes.
ex.zh: 這種疾病是由蚊子傳染的。

ex.en: The game was transmitted live around the world.
ex.zh: 這場比賽向全世界現場轉播。

transmit.en: to send information or a signal to another place, or to pass a disease to someone

ex.en: Traditionally, families eat together on Lunar New Year's Eve.
ex.zh: 傳統上，家人會在除夕夜一起吃年夜飯。

ex.en: This dish is traditionally served with rice.
ex.zh: 這道菜傳統上會搭配白飯。

traditionally.en: in the way that has been done for a long time

ex.en: The pressure was tremendous.
ex.zh: 壓力非常大。

ex.en: The rocket travels at a tremendous speed.
ex.zh: 火箭以極快的速度飛行。

ex.en: She put a tremendous amount of work into the report.
ex.zh: 她為這份報告投入了大量心力。

tremendous.en: very great in size, amount or strength

ex.en: You did a tremendous job on the presentation.
ex.zh: 你的簡報做得非常棒。

ex.en: We had a tremendous time at the party.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上玩得非常開心。

ex.en: The company registered the name as a trademark.
ex.zh: 公司把這個名稱註冊為商標。

ex.en: You can't use their trademark without permission.
ex.zh: 未經許可不能使用他們的商標。

trademark.en: a name or symbol that a company legally owns and uses on its products

ex.en: His friendly smile is his trademark.
ex.zh: 親切的笑容是他的招牌。

ex.en: Spicy food is the trademark of this restaurant.
ex.zh: 辣味料理是這家餐廳的招牌。

trademark.en: a special feature by which a person or thing is easily recognized

ex.en: This kind of plant grows only in the tropical regions.
ex.zh: 這類植物只生長在熱帶地區。

ex.en: We're going to a tropical island for our vacation.
ex.zh: 我們要去熱帶島嶼度假。

ex.en: Southern Taiwan has a tropical climate.
ex.zh: 台灣南部屬於熱帶氣候。

tropical.en: from or related to the hot, wet parts of the world near the equator

ex.en: He works as a trader at an investment bank.
ex.zh: 他在投資銀行當交易員。

ex.en: Local traders sell fruit at the market.
ex.zh: 當地商販在市場賣水果。

trader.en: a person whose job is buying and selling goods or shares

ex.en: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
ex.zh: 1978 年，日本和中國簽訂了和平條約。

ex.en: The Sioux had signed a treaty with the government in 1868.
ex.zh: 蘇族在 1868 年和政府簽訂了一項條約。

ex.en: The two countries signed a trade treaty.
ex.zh: 兩國簽署了一項貿易條約。

treaty.en: a formal written agreement between countries

ex.en: The bank acts as trustee for the fund.
ex.zh: 銀行擔任這個基金的受託人。

ex.en: She is a trustee of the museum.
ex.zh: 她是博物館的理事。

trustee.en: a person who looks after money or property for others, or sits on a managing board

ex.en: The Treasury announced new tax measures.
ex.zh: 財政部宣布了新的稅務措施。

ex.en: The money will go back to the national treasury.
ex.zh: 這筆錢將歸還國庫。

treasury.en: the government department that manages a country's money, or the place where public funds are kept

ex.en: Investors bought US Treasury bonds.
ex.zh: 投資人買進美國公債。

ex.en: Treasury yields rose sharply this week.
ex.zh: 美國公債殖利率本週大幅上升。

treasury.en: a loan certificate sold by the US government that pays interest to the buyer

ex.en: The company is going through a digital transformation.
ex.zh: 公司正在進行數位轉型。

ex.en: The city has undergone a complete transformation.
ex.zh: 這座城市徹底改頭換面了。

transformation.en: a complete change in the form or nature of something

ex.en: I've heard Italian is a tricky language.
ex.zh: 聽說義大利文是很難學的語言。

ex.en: This is an East Asian concept -- it's a little tricky to explain in Spanish.
ex.zh: 這是東亞的概念，用西班牙文有點難解釋。

ex.en: This is a tricky situation.
ex.zh: 這個情況很棘手。

tricky.en: difficult to deal with and needing careful handling

ex.en: Investors are demanding more transparency from the company.
ex.zh: 投資人要求公司提高透明度。

ex.en: The government promised greater transparency in spending.
ex.zh: 政府承諾讓支出更加公開透明。

ex.en: Transparency builds trust between managers and employees.
ex.zh: 公開透明能建立主管和員工之間的信任。

transparency.en: the quality of being open and honest so that others can see what is happening

ex.en: In America, the consumption of fast-food has tripled between 1977 and 1995.
ex.zh: 在美國，速食的消費量在 1977 到 1995 年間成長為三倍。

ex.en: Our sales tripled last year.
ex.zh: 我們去年的銷售額成長了兩倍（變成三倍）。

triple.en: to become three times as large, or to make something three times as large

ex.en: The hotel charges triple the normal rate during holidays.
ex.zh: 飯店在假期收取平常三倍的房價。

ex.en: I'd like a triple espresso, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一杯三份濃縮咖啡。

triple.en: three times as big or as much, or made of three parts

ex.en: The case was taken to an international tribunal.
ex.zh: 這個案子被送到國際法庭審理。

ex.en: The tribunal ruled in favor of the employee.
ex.zh: 仲裁庭做出了對員工有利的裁決。

tribunal.en: a special court or group that decides on a particular kind of dispute

ex.en: The product launch was a great triumph.
ex.zh: 這次產品發表大獲成功。

ex.en: Winning the award was a personal triumph for her.
ex.zh: 得獎對她來說是一項個人的重大成就。

ex.en: It is said that truth always triumphs.
ex.zh: 有人說，真理終將獲勝。

ex.en: I believe he will triumph.
ex.zh: 我相信他會獲勝。

ex.en: As long as good people do nothing, evil will triumph.
ex.zh: 只要好人袖手旁觀，邪惡就會得勝。

triumph.en: to win or succeed in a way that is impressive

ex.en: Did you trim the apple trees?
ex.zh: 你修剪過那些蘋果樹了嗎？

ex.en: Trim the fat off the meat.
ex.zh: 把肉上的肥肉切掉。

trim.en: to cut a little off something to make it neat or to remove unwanted parts

ex.en: The company plans to trim costs by 10 percent.
ex.zh: 公司計畫削減一成的成本。

ex.en: We had to trim the marketing budget.
ex.zh: 我們不得不刪減行銷預算。

trim.en: to make an amount smaller by removing some of it

ex.en: I just need a trim, please.
ex.zh: 我只要稍微修一下就好。

ex.en: Your beard needs a trim.
ex.zh: 你的鬍子該修一修了。

trim.en: a small cut to make hair or a plant neat

ex.en: Confidence and courage are not just masculine traits; they are values anyone can strive for.
ex.zh: 自信與勇氣不只是男性的特質，而是每個人都能追求的價值。

ex.en: Honesty is an important trait in a leader.
ex.zh: 誠實是領導者的重要特質。

trait.en: a particular quality in someone's character or appearance

tranche.zh: （款項、貸款分批撥付的）一期、一部分

ex.en: The first tranche of the loan will be paid next month.
ex.zh: 第一期貸款會在下個月撥付。

ex.en: The investors released the second tranche of funding.
ex.zh: 投資人撥出了第二期資金。

tranche.en: one of several parts of a sum of money that is paid or sold at different times

ex.en: The village holds a tribal festival every summer.
ex.zh: 這個村子每年夏天都會舉辦部落祭典。

ex.en: They still follow many tribal customs.
ex.zh: 他們仍然遵循許多部落習俗。

tribal.en: belonging to a group of people who share the same ancestors, language and customs

ex.en: Members of that tribe settled along the river.
ex.zh: 那個部落的人沿著河岸定居。

ex.en: The Zulu tribe in South Africa has its own language.
ex.zh: 南非的祖魯族有自己的語言。

tribe.en: a group of people with the same ancestors, language and customs, living together

ex.en: I tried to change her mind, but I couldn't.
ex.zh: 我試著改變她的心意，但沒辦法。

ex.en: I'm trying hard, but can't think of her name.
ex.zh: 我很努力想，但就是想不起她的名字。

try.en: to make an effort to do something

ex.en: You should try the beef noodles here.
ex.zh: 你應該試試這裡的牛肉麵。

ex.en: Have you tried the new app?
ex.zh: 你試用過那個新 App 了嗎？

try.en: to use or taste something to see if you like it or if it works

ex.en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
ex.zh: 我喜歡這條裙子，可以試穿嗎？

ex.en: Would you like to try on a larger size?
ex.zh: 您要試穿大一號的嗎？

try.en: to put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits and looks good

ex.en: We had three tries and failed each time.
ex.zh: 我們試了三次，每次都失敗。

ex.en: Let's give it a try.
ex.zh: 我們試試看吧。

ex.en: Is it true that you are going to Paris?
ex.zh: 你真的要去巴黎嗎？

ex.en: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.
ex.zh: 這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪，但完全是真的。

ex.en: It is true that television also has some disadvantages.
ex.zh: 電視確實也有一些缺點。

true.en: agreeing with the facts and not wrong

ex.en: It won't be long before your dream comes true.
ex.zh: 你的夢想很快就會實現了。

ex.en: I hope your wish comes true.
ex.zh: 希望你的願望會實現。

true.en: to happen in the way that was hoped for

ex.en: He is a true friend.
ex.zh: 他是真正的朋友。

ex.en: She is a true professional.
ex.zh: 她是真正的專業人士。

ex.en: My father traveled all over the world by air.
ex.zh: 我父親搭飛機環遊過世界。

ex.en: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.
ex.zh: 如果可以，我想環遊世界。

ex.en: His big sister has never travelled to China.
ex.zh: 他姊姊從沒去過中國旅行。

travel.en: to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance

ex.en: Light travels faster than sound.
ex.zh: 光傳播的速度比聲音快。

ex.en: News travels fast in a small town.
ex.zh: 小鎮裡消息傳得很快。

travel.en: to move or spread through space or a medium

ex.en: The company pays for all business travel.
ex.zh: 公司支付所有出差費用。

ex.en: Air travel has become much cheaper.
ex.zh: 搭飛機旅行變得便宜多了。

travel.en: the activity of going from place to place, especially for a journey or for work

ex.en: The tree is about as high as the roof.
ex.zh: 這棵樹差不多跟屋頂一樣高。

ex.en: This is the tallest tree I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最高的樹。

ex.en: The leaves fall off the trees in the fall.
ex.zh: 秋天時樹葉會從樹上掉落。

tree.en: a tall plant with a thick wooden trunk, branches and leaves

ex.en: I do not like the way he treats others.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡他對待別人的方式。

ex.en: He treats me as if I am a stranger.
ex.zh: 他把我當陌生人看待。

ex.en: It doesn't seem very fair to treat him like this.
ex.zh: 這樣對待他似乎不太公平。

treat.en: to behave toward someone or deal with something in a particular way

ex.en: The doctor treated her for a broken arm.
ex.zh: 醫生為她治療骨折的手臂。

ex.en: This illness can be treated with medicine.
ex.zh: 這種病可以用藥物治療。

treat.en: to give medical care to a person to cure an illness or injury

ex.en: Let me treat you to lunch.
ex.zh: 讓我請你吃午餐。

ex.en: My boss treated us to dinner.
ex.zh: 老闆請我們吃晚餐。

treat.en: to pay for someone's food, drink or entertainment as a gift

ex.en: This one's my treat.
ex.zh: 這次我請客。

ex.en: We went out for ice cream as a treat.
ex.zh: 我們出去吃冰淇淋犒賞自己。

treat.en: something special that you pay for or give to someone as a gift or pleasure

ex.en: You should stay in the hospital for treatment.
ex.zh: 你應該留院接受治療。

ex.en: About how much will I have to pay for all the treatments?
ex.zh: 全部治療大概要付多少錢？

ex.en: You must complete the treatment until the end.
ex.zh: 你必須把療程做完。

treatment.en: medical care given to a sick or injured person

ex.en: He asked her to give him preferential treatment.
ex.zh: 他要求她給他特殊待遇。

ex.en: Everyone deserves fair treatment at work.
ex.zh: 每個人在職場上都應受到公平對待。

treatment.en: the way someone is acted toward or dealt with by others

ex.en: How are you? Did you have a good trip?
ex.zh: 你好嗎？旅途愉快嗎？

ex.en: You must be tired after such a long trip.
ex.zh: 這麼長的旅程後你一定很累了。

ex.en: I'm going on a business trip to Tokyo next week.
ex.zh: 我下週要去東京出差。

trip.en: a journey to a place and back again

ex.en: Entering the house, I tripped over the mat.
ex.zh: 一進家門，我就被腳踏墊絆倒了。

ex.en: I would've won if I hadn't tripped.
ex.zh: 要不是絆了一下，我本來會贏的。

trip.en: to catch your foot on something and fall or nearly fall

ex.en: I'll be in trouble if the story gets out.
ex.zh: 要是這件事傳出去，我就麻煩了。

ex.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
ex.zh: 電腦幫我們省下很多時間和麻煩。

ex.en: I had trouble finding the hotel.
ex.zh: 我費了一番功夫才找到飯店。

trouble.en: a difficult or dangerous situation, or a problem

ex.en: I'm very sorry to have troubled you.
ex.zh: 很抱歉打擾你了。

ex.en: Everyone has something that's troubling him.
ex.zh: 每個人都有煩心的事。

trouble.en: to disturb someone, or to make someone feel worried

ex.en: The car has engine trouble.
ex.zh: 這輛車的引擎出了問題。

ex.en: We're having trouble with the printer again.
ex.zh: 印表機又出問題了。

trouble.en: a fault that stops a machine from working well

ex.en: The subscription service is available for a fixed monthly fee with a one-month free trial.
ex.zh: 此訂閱服務收取固定月費，並提供一個月免費試用。

ex.en: The new system is still on trial.
ex.zh: 新系統還在試用階段。

trial.en: a test of something new to see how well it works

ex.en: Tom's trial will continue on October 20th.
ex.zh: 湯姆的審判將於 10 月 20 日繼續進行。

ex.en: The truth finally came out at his trial.
ex.zh: 真相終於在他的審判中水落石出。

trial.en: a legal process in a court to decide whether a person is guilty

ex.en: I wish you had told me the truth then.
ex.zh: 真希望你當時就告訴我實話。

ex.en: It won't be long before we know the truth.
ex.zh: 我們很快就會知道真相。

ex.en: Not until this morning did I learn the truth.
ex.zh: 直到今天早上我才知道真相。

truth.en: what is real and correct, as opposed to what is false

ex.en: Every opinion is a mixture of truth and mistakes.
ex.zh: 每種意見都是真理與錯誤的混合。

ex.en: There is some truth in what you say.
ex.zh: 你說的有幾分道理。

truth.en: a fact or idea that is generally accepted as correct

ex.en: This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車把新鮮食品從青森運到東京。

ex.en: Many goods are now transported by air.
ex.zh: 現在很多貨物都用空運。

ex.en: The goods were transported by ship.
ex.zh: 這批貨物是用船運送的。

transport.en: to carry people or goods from one place to another

ex.en: Public transport in Taipei is very convenient.
ex.zh: 台北的大眾運輸非常方便。

ex.en: The price includes transport to the hotel.
ex.zh: 價格包含到飯店的接送。

transport.en: the system or vehicles used for moving people and goods

ex.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天容易發生交通事故。

ex.en: After you get to the traffic lights, turn right.
ex.zh: 到了紅綠燈之後右轉。

ex.en: Traffic conditions on the highway are normal this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上高速公路的交通狀況正常。

traffic.en: the cars and other vehicles moving along a road

ex.en: Our website traffic doubled last month.
ex.zh: 我們網站的流量上個月成長了一倍。

ex.en: Social media brings a lot of traffic to the site.
ex.zh: 社群媒體為網站帶來大量流量。

traffic.en: the number of people who visit a website

ex.en: Napoleon led his troops to Russia.
ex.zh: 拿破崙率領軍隊前往俄羅斯。

ex.en: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.
ex.zh: 地形崎嶇，讓部隊難以前進。

ex.en: A troop of children followed the tour guide.
ex.zh: 一群孩子跟著導遊走。

ex.en: A troop of monkeys lives on the hill.
ex.zh: 山上住著一群猴子。

troop.en: a group of people or animals moving together

ex.en: I truly do not understand the question.
ex.zh: 我真的不懂這個問題。

ex.en: I swear, this time it's truly different.
ex.zh: 我發誓，這次真的不一樣。

ex.en: Cleaning up the house is truly my most dreaded task.
ex.zh: 打掃房子真的是我最怕的家事。

truly.en: in a way that is real and sincere

truly.zh: Yours truly：（信件結尾）謹啟、敬上

ex.en: She ended the letter with "Yours truly."
ex.zh: 她在信的結尾寫上「敬上」。

ex.en: Many formal letters close with "Yours truly."
ex.zh: 許多正式信件以「謹啟」結尾。

truly.en: a polite phrase written at the end of a letter before the writer's name

ex.en: He disappeared without a trace.
ex.zh: 他消失得無影無蹤。

ex.en: There is a trace on the table.
ex.zh: 桌子上有個痕跡。

trace.en: a mark or sign that shows someone or something was there

ex.en: There was a trace of sadness in her voice.
ex.zh: 她的聲音裡帶著一絲哀傷。

ex.en: The water contains traces of chemicals.
ex.zh: 這水裡含有微量的化學物質。

trace.en: a very small amount of something

ex.en: The burglar was traced by one of the things he had left on the scene.
ex.zh: 竊賊因為留在現場的一件物品而被查出來。

ex.en: We traced the problem to a faulty cable.
ex.zh: 我們查出問題出在一條故障的線。

ex.en: The company traces its history back to 1920.
ex.zh: 這家公司的歷史可以追溯到 1920 年。

trace.en: to find someone or something by following signs, or to find where something began

ex.en: This truck transports fresh food from Aomori to Tokyo.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車把新鮮食品從青森運到東京。

ex.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車最大載重是 5 噸。

ex.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
ex.zh: 一輛卡車停在路中間。

truck.en: a large road vehicle for carrying goods

ex.en: The goods were trucked to the warehouse.
ex.zh: 這批貨用卡車運到了倉庫。

ex.en: They truck vegetables to the city every morning.
ex.zh: 他們每天早上用卡車把蔬菜運進城。

truck.en: to carry goods somewhere in a large road vehicle

ex.en: Images and videos are transformed into gifs and memes.
ex.zh: 圖片和影片被轉成 GIF 和迷因。

ex.en: The internet has transformed the way we work.
ex.zh: 網路徹底改變了我們的工作方式。

ex.en: They transformed the old warehouse into a modern office.
ex.zh: 他們把舊倉庫改造成現代化的辦公室。

transform.en: to change something completely in form or nature

ex.en: We hiked along a mountain trail.
ex.zh: 我們沿著山間步道健行。

ex.en: The trail is closed due to heavy rain.
ex.zh: 步道因大雨而封閉。

trail.en: a narrow path through the countryside

ex.en: The frustrated artist stomped on his failed painting, leaving a trail of shattered colors.
ex.zh: 那位受挫的畫家狠狠踩著自己失敗的畫作，留下一片破碎的色彩。

ex.en: The thief left a trail of footprints in the snow.
ex.zh: 小偷在雪地上留下一串腳印。

trail.en: a line of marks or things left behind by someone or something that has passed

ex.en: Our team trailed by ten points at halftime.
ex.zh: 我們隊上半場落後十分。

ex.en: The company trails its rivals in online sales.
ex.zh: 公司在網路銷售上落後於競爭對手。

trail.en: to be behind another person or team in a competition

ex.en: We set a trap to catch a fox.
ex.zh: 我們設了陷阱來抓狐狸。

ex.en: I know how to set a trap.
ex.zh: 我知道怎麼設陷阱。

trap.en: a device for catching animals, or a trick to catch a person

ex.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.
ex.zh: 很多工人被困在煤礦裡。

ex.en: I am trapped in Boston by the storm.
ex.zh: 我因為暴風雨被困在波士頓。

trap.en: to keep someone in a place or situation they cannot escape from

ex.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
ex.zh: 從硬體到軟體的轉變是逐步發生的。

ex.en: The transition to the new system went smoothly.
ex.zh: 轉換到新系統的過程很順利。

ex.en: Students need time to make the transition to college life.
ex.zh: 學生需要時間適應大學生活。

transition.en: a change from one state or situation to another, or the period when this happens

ex.en: I'd like you to translate this book into English.
ex.zh: 我想請你把這本書翻成英文。

ex.en: We know it's difficult, but please don't translate literally.
ex.zh: 我們知道這很難，但請不要逐字直譯。

translate.en: to change words from one language into another

ex.en: Good ideas don't always translate into profits.
ex.zh: 好點子不一定能轉化為利潤。

ex.en: Higher sales should translate into bigger bonuses.
ex.zh: 銷售額提高應該會帶來更多獎金。

translate.en: to result in or be changed into something else

ex.en: Their small protest triggered a mass demonstration.
ex.zh: 他們的小型抗議引發了大規模的示威遊行。

ex.en: Opening the door will trigger the alarm.
ex.zh: 打開門會觸發警報。

ex.en: Stress can trigger headaches.
ex.zh: 壓力可能會引發頭痛。

trigger.en: to cause something to start or happen

ex.en: Pull the trigger to start the spray.
ex.zh: 扣下扳機就會開始噴灑。

ex.en: Dust is a common trigger for allergies.
ex.zh: 灰塵是常見的過敏誘因。

trigger.en: the part of a gun that you press to fire it, or something that starts an event

ex.en: Tom tricked Mary into doing his work for him.
ex.zh: 湯姆騙瑪麗幫他做事。

ex.en: You're not trying to trick me, are you?
ex.zh: 你不是想騙我吧？

ex.en: Old people were tricked by the shop assistant.
ex.zh: 老人們被店員騙了。

trick.en: to deceive someone so that they do something

ex.en: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.
ex.zh: 老狗學不會新把戲。

ex.en: The magician showed us a card trick.
ex.zh: 魔術師表演了一個紙牌戲法給我們看。

trick.en: an action meant to fool someone, or a clever act that seems like magic

ex.en: The trick is to add the sugar slowly.
ex.zh: 訣竅是慢慢加糖。

ex.en: Do you know any tricks for remembering words?
ex.zh: 你知道什麼記單字的訣竅嗎？

trick.en: a clever or skillful way of doing something easily

ex.en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
ex.zh: 這家飯店搭乘大眾運輸很方便。

ex.en: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
ex.zh: 這個城市的交通非常方便。

ex.en: This place isn't convenient to public transportation.
ex.zh: 這個地方搭大眾運輸不方便。

transportation.en: the vehicles and systems people use to travel from place to place

ex.en: The price includes transportation and insurance.
ex.zh: 價格包含運費和保險。

ex.en: Transportation costs have gone up this year.
ex.zh: 今年的運輸成本上升了。

transportation.en: the act of moving goods or people from one place to another

ex.en: The company bought a large tract of land.
ex.zh: 公司買下了一大片土地。

ex.en: Vast tracts of forest have been cut down.
ex.zh: 大片森林已經被砍伐。

ex.en: The infection affects the respiratory tract.
ex.zh: 這種感染會影響呼吸道。

ex.en: Food passes through the digestive tract.
ex.zh: 食物會通過消化道。

tract.en: a system of connected tubes in the body that carries food or air

ex.en: Scientists calculated the trajectory of the rocket.
ex.zh: 科學家計算了火箭的軌道。

ex.en: The ball's trajectory was hard to predict.
ex.zh: 這顆球的軌跡很難預測。

trajectory.en: the curved path of something moving through the air or space

ex.en: Her career trajectory has been impressive.
ex.zh: 她的職涯發展令人印象深刻。

ex.en: The company is on an upward trajectory.
ex.zh: 這家公司正處於上升階段。

trajectory.en: the way something develops over time

transcribe.zh: 把（錄音等）轉成文字、謄寫

ex.en: Please transcribe the interview recording.
ex.zh: 請把訪談錄音轉成文字。

ex.en: The software can transcribe speech into text.
ex.zh: 這套軟體能把語音轉成文字。

transcribe.en: to write down in full something that was said or recorded

ex.en: The transcription of the meeting will be sent tomorrow.
ex.zh: 會議的逐字稿明天會寄出。

ex.en: We use an app for audio transcription.
ex.zh: 我們用一個應用程式來做錄音轉文字。

transcription.en: a written copy of something spoken, or the act of making one

ex.en: He is waiting for a heart transplant.
ex.zh: 他在等待心臟移植。

ex.en: The kidney transplant was a success.
ex.zh: 腎臟移植手術很成功。

transplant.en: a medical operation in which a body part is moved from one person to another

ex.en: Doctors transplanted a kidney from his brother.
ex.zh: 醫生把他哥哥的腎臟移植給他。

ex.en: Transplant the seedlings when they are ten centimeters tall.
ex.zh: 幼苗長到十公分高時再移植。

transplant.en: to move an organ or a plant from one place or body to another

ex.en: Many survivors of the earthquake still suffer from trauma.
ex.zh: 許多地震倖存者至今仍受心理創傷所苦。

ex.en: Losing his job was a real trauma for him.
ex.zh: 失業對他來說是很大的打擊。

trauma.en: a deep emotional shock caused by a very bad experience

ex.en: The patient was taken to the hospital with severe head trauma.
ex.zh: 病患因頭部嚴重外傷被送往醫院。

ex.en: She works as a nurse in the trauma unit.
ex.zh: 她在創傷科當護理師。

trauma.en: a physical injury to the body

ex.en: Please find the area of the triangle.
ex.zh: 請求出這個三角形的面積。

ex.en: A triangle has 3 corners, and a hexagon has 6 corners.
ex.zh: 三角形有三個角，六邊形則有六個角。

ex.en: Cut the sandwich into two triangles.
ex.zh: 把三明治切成兩個三角形。

triangle.en: a flat shape with three straight sides and three corners

ex.en: The movie is about a love triangle between three friends.
ex.zh: 這部電影講的是三個朋友之間的三角戀。

ex.en: She didn't want to be part of a triangle.
ex.zh: 她不想捲入三角關係。

triangle.en: a situation involving three people with complicated feelings toward one another

ex.en: Forget it, those are just trivial details.
ex.zh: 算了，那些只是無關緊要的細節。

ex.en: This isn't a trivial matter.
ex.zh: 這可不是小事。

ex.en: Don't waste time arguing about trivial issues.
ex.zh: 別浪費時間爭論雞毛蒜皮的小事。

trek.zh: 長途跋涉、健行（尤指艱苦的）

ex.en: The trek to the base camp took five days.
ex.zh: 前往基地營的長途健行花了五天。

ex.en: It's a long trek from the parking lot to the office.
ex.zh: 從停車場走到辦公室要走很遠。

trek.en: a long and difficult journey on foot

ex.en: We trekked through the mountains for a week.
ex.zh: 我們在山裡跋涉了一個星期。

ex.en: I had to trek across town to pick up the documents.
ex.zh: 我得穿越整個城鎮去拿那些文件。

trek.en: to walk a long way, usually with difficulty

ex.en: There must be some way of traversing the river.
ex.zh: 一定有辦法過河。

ex.en: The train traverses the whole country in two days.
ex.zh: 這列火車兩天內橫越全國。

traverse.en: to travel across an area or a stretch of water

ex.en: I don't care if you trust me or not.
ex.zh: 我不在乎你信不信任我。

ex.en: To what extent can he be trusted?
ex.zh: 他可以信任到什麼程度？

ex.en: No one trusts him any more.
ex.zh: 沒有人再相信他了。

trust.en: to believe that someone is honest and will not harm you

ex.en: Trust is important in any relationship.
ex.zh: 信任在任何關係中都很重要。

ex.en: It takes years to build trust.
ex.zh: 建立信任需要好幾年。

trust.en: a strong belief that someone is honest and reliable

ex.en: I like this skirt. May I try it on?
ex.zh: 我喜歡這件裙子，可以試穿嗎？

ex.en: Can I try on this pair of shoes?
ex.zh: 我可以試穿這雙鞋嗎？

ex.en: I'd like to try this on. Where are the fitting rooms?
ex.zh: 我想試穿這件，請問試衣間在哪裡？

try on.en: to put on clothes to see if they fit and look good

ex.en: The bank charges a fee for each transaction.
ex.zh: 銀行每筆交易都會收手續費。

ex.en: Check your recent transactions in the app.
ex.zh: 在 App 裡查看最近的交易紀錄。

transaction.en: an act of buying, selling or exchanging money or goods

ex.en: The trash is really starting to pile up.
ex.zh: 垃圾真的越堆越多了。

ex.en: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
ex.zh: 在新加坡，在街上亂丟垃圾會被罰款。

ex.en: This trash bag does not contain any dangerous chemicals.
ex.zh: 這個垃圾袋不含任何有害化學物質。

trash.en: things that you throw away because you do not want them

ex.en: Workers dug a long trench for the water pipe.
ex.zh: 工人為了水管挖了一道長長的溝。

ex.en: Soldiers lived in the trenches for months.
ex.zh: 士兵們在戰壕裡住了好幾個月。

trench.en: a long narrow hole dug in the ground, or one where soldiers shelter in war

ex.en: She enjoyed the tranquility of the countryside.
ex.zh: 她享受鄉間的寧靜。

ex.en: The lake was a place of perfect tranquility.
ex.zh: 那座湖是個絕對寧靜的地方。

tranquility.en: a calm, quiet and peaceful state

ex.en: They both cried after hearing the tragic news.
ex.zh: 聽到這件悲劇，他倆盡皆哭泣。

ex.en: The tragic accident took the lives of three people.
ex.zh: 那起悲慘的意外奪走了三條人命。

ex.en: It is tragic that so many young people die in car crashes.
ex.zh: 這麼多年輕人死於車禍，實在令人悲痛。

tragic.en: causing great sadness, or involving death and suffering

ex.en: It is the first step which is troublesome.
ex.zh: 第一步是最麻煩的。

ex.en: In any case, it's troublesome, isn't it?
ex.zh: 無論怎樣，都很討厭，不是嗎？

ex.en: The troublesome child kept interrupting the lesson.
ex.zh: 那個調皮搗蛋的孩子一直打斷上課。

ex.en: The triumphant team lifted the trophy over their heads.
ex.zh: 獲勝的球隊把獎盃高舉過頭。

ex.en: He gave a triumphant smile after winning the argument.
ex.zh: 他在辯論獲勝後露出得意的微笑。

triumphant.en: having won, or feeling very happy and proud about a success

ex.en: This would be a terrible tragedy.
ex.zh: 這將是一個可怕的悲劇。

ex.en: A single death is a tragedy, a million deaths is a statistic.
ex.zh: 死一個人是悲劇，死一百萬人只是統計數字。

ex.en: All tragedies end with a death.
ex.zh: 所有的悲劇都以死亡收場。

tragedy.en: a very sad event, or a serious play with a sad ending

ex.en: The doctor gave the anxious patient a mild tranquilizer.
ex.zh: 醫生給焦慮的病人一劑溫和的鎮靜劑。

ex.en: The zookeeper used a tranquilizer to calm the injured tiger.
ex.zh: 動物園管理員用鎮靜劑讓受傷的老虎安靜下來。

tranquilizer.en: a drug that makes a person feel calm or helps them sleep

ex.en: Good music can transcend language and cultural differences.
ex.zh: 好的音樂能超越語言和文化的差異。

ex.en: Their friendship transcended age, class, and nationality.
ex.zh: 他們的友誼超越了年齡、階級和國籍。

transcend.en: to go beyond the limits of something

ex.en: Are some of you from the US trade delegation?
ex.zh: 請問你們有人是美國貿易代表團的嗎？

ex.en: Trade between the two countries has grown.
ex.zh: 兩國之間的貿易成長了。

trade.en: the activity of buying and selling goods, especially between countries

ex.en: Japan trades with several foreign countries.
ex.zh: 日本和好幾個國家有貿易往來。

ex.en: He amassed a fortune in stock trading during the last boom.
ex.zh: 他在上一波景氣時炒股賺了一大筆錢。

trade.en: to buy and sell goods or services

ex.en: John likes to trade stamps with his friends.
ex.zh: 約翰喜歡和朋友交換郵票。

ex.en: I traded in my old car for a new one.
ex.zh: 我用舊車換了一輛新車。

trade.en: to give something to someone and get something else from them

ex.en: It is a Chinese tradition to welcome spring with flowers.
ex.zh: 用花迎接春天是中國的傳統。

ex.en: We must keep up the family traditions.
ex.zh: 我們必須維持家族傳統。

ex.en: We must have respect for tradition.
ex.zh: 我們要尊重傳統。

tradition.en: a custom or belief passed down in a group for a long time

ex.en: But I haven't looked up this tracking number on the DHL website.
ex.zh: 可是我還沒在 DHL 網站上查這個追蹤號碼。

ex.en: You'll receive a tracking number by email.
ex.zh: 您會透過電子郵件收到追蹤號碼。

tracking number.en: a code used to follow where a parcel is on its way to you

ex.en: Some items were damaged in transit.
ex.zh: 有些物品在運送途中損壞了。

ex.en: Passengers in transit do not need a visa.
ex.zh: 過境旅客不需要簽證。

transit.en: the movement of goods or people from one place to another, or a stop on the way

ex.en: Public transit in Taipei is fast and cheap.
ex.zh: 台北的大眾運輸又快又便宜。

ex.en: The city is investing in mass transit.
ex.zh: 這座城市正在投資大眾運輸系統。

transit.en: buses, trains and other public vehicles that carry many people around a city

ex.en: We will show our new products at the trade show.
ex.zh: 我們會在商展上展示新產品。

ex.en: The Computex trade show is held in Taipei every year.
ex.zh: 台北國際電腦展每年在台北舉行。

trade show.en: an event where companies show their products to other businesses and buyers

ex.en: Training will be provided.
ex.zh: 公司會提供訓練。

ex.en: No matter how hard the training was, she never cried.
ex.zh: 不管訓練多麼艱苦，她都沒有哭過。

ex.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
ex.zh: 經過多年艱苦的訓練，她終於有所突破，奪得冠軍。

training.en: the process of learning the skills needed for a job or activity

ex.en: I work in a travel agency.
ex.zh: 我在旅行社工作.

ex.en: Where's the nearest travel agency?
ex.zh: 最近的旅行社在哪裡？

travel agency.en: a business that arranges trips and bookings for people

ex.en: The IT team helped me troubleshoot my laptop.
ex.zh: 資訊部門幫我排除筆電的問題。

ex.en: This guide explains how to troubleshoot common problems.
ex.zh: 這份指南說明如何排除常見問題。

troubleshoot.en: to find and fix the cause of a problem in a machine or system

ex.en: The country reported a smaller trade deficit this year.
ex.zh: 該國今年公布的貿易逆差較小。

ex.en: Rising imports contributed to the trade deficit.
ex.zh: 進口增加造成貿易逆差。

trade deficit.en: the amount by which a country buys more from other countries than it sells to them

ex.en: The nation recorded a trade surplus in May.
ex.zh: 該國五月呈現貿易順差。

ex.en: Exports helped the country maintain its trade surplus.
ex.zh: 出口協助該國維持貿易順差。

trade surplus.en: the amount by which a country sells more to other countries than it buys from them

ex.en: A free-trade agreement between Europe and the United States is currently under negotiation.
ex.zh: 歐洲與美國目前正在協商一項自由貿易協定。

ex.en: The trade agreement reduced tariffs on farm products.
ex.zh: 這項貿易協定降低了農產品的關稅。

trade agreement.en: a deal between countries about how goods will be bought and sold between them

ex.en: The goods require transshipment at the Singapore port.
ex.zh: 這批貨物需要在新加坡港轉運。

ex.en: Transshipment added two days to the delivery schedule.
ex.zh: 轉運使交貨時程多了兩天。

transshipment.en: the moving of goods from one ship or vehicle to another during a journey

ex.en: The company will introduce its new products at the trade fair.
ex.zh: 公司將在商展上介紹新產品。

ex.en: We met several overseas buyers at the trade fair.
ex.zh: 我們在貿易展上認識了幾位海外買家。

trade fair.en: a large event where companies show and sell their products

ex.en: I resigned from my position as club treasurer.
ex.zh: 我辭去了社團司庫一職。

ex.en: The treasurer presented the budget at the meeting.
ex.zh: 財務主管在會議上提出預算。

treasurer.en: a person who looks after the money of a club or organization

ex.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
ex.zh: 電晶體的發明開啟了一個新時代。

ex.en: The chip contains millions of tiny transistors.
ex.zh: 這款晶片含有數百萬個微小電晶體。

transistor.en: a small electronic part that controls or increases the flow of electric current

ex.en: Every day I take the tram to the office.
ex.zh: 我每天搭電車上班。

ex.en: She takes the tram across town instead of driving.

ex.en: Studying abroad was a transformative experience for her.
ex.zh: 出國留學對她來說是一次帶來巨大改變的經驗。

ex.en: The new technology could have a transformative effect on education.
ex.zh: 這項新科技可能對教育產生徹底的改變。

ex.en: A bird sat on the treetop and sang.
ex.zh: 一隻鳥站在樹梢上唱歌。

ex.en: The sun shone over the treetops.
ex.zh: 陽光灑在樹梢上。

ex.en: The patient is waiting for a kidney transplantation.
ex.zh: 那位病人正在等待腎臟移植。

ex.en: The transplantation of young trees should be done in spring.
ex.zh: 幼樹的移植最好在春天進行。

ex.en: She opened the exam results with some trepidation.
ex.zh: 她帶著些許忐忑打開了成績單。

ex.en: He approached the dark cave with trepidation.
ex.zh: 他心懷恐懼地走近那個黑暗的洞穴。

ex.en: The teacher called him a troublemaker because he never followed rules.
ex.zh: 老師說他是個惹麻煩的人，因為他從不守規矩。

ex.en: Don't be a troublemaker; just wait your turn.
ex.zh: 別當個搗蛋鬼，乖乖等輪到你。

treated.zh: 對待；治療（treat 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The nurse treated the wound and put a bandage on it.
ex.zh: 護士處理了傷口並貼上繃帶。

ex.en: She was treated very kindly by the hotel staff.
ex.zh: 飯店員工對她非常親切。

ex.en: My cousin is a triplet, and he has two brothers his age.
ex.zh: 我表弟是三胞胎之一，有兩個同齡的兄弟。

ex.en: Each triplet had a different favorite toy.
ex.zh: 三胞胎裡每一個都有自己不同的最愛玩具。

ex.en: The poem is written in triplets of three lines each.
ex.zh: 這首詩由每段三行的三行組成。

ex.en: The musician played a quick triplet of notes.
ex.zh: 音樂家彈了一組快速的三連音。

ex.en: The trapper checked his traps along the frozen river.
ex.zh: 獵人沿著結冰的河檢查他設下的陷阱。

ex.en: An old trapper told stories of winters in the wilderness.
ex.zh: 一位年老的捕獸人講述了在荒野過冬的故事。

ex.en: The trembling child held her mother's hand.
ex.zh: 發抖的孩子握住媽媽的手。

ex.en: He spoke in a trembling voice.
ex.zh: 他用顫抖的聲音說話。

ex.en: Good communication is a transferable skill that helps in any job.
ex.zh: 良好的溝通是在任何工作都用得上的可轉移技能。

ex.en: This ticket is not transferable to another person.
ex.zh: 這張票不能轉讓給別人。

ex.en: He wore a gray tracksuit to the gym.
ex.zh: 他穿著灰色運動服去健身房。

ex.en: I bought a warm tracksuit for the winter mornings.
ex.zh: 我為冬天的早晨買了一套保暖的運動服。

ex.en: I put a small tracker on my keys so I can find them.
ex.zh: 我在鑰匙上放了一個小追蹤器，這樣就找得到。

ex.en: This fitness tracker counts your steps every day.
ex.zh: 這個健身追蹤器每天都會計算你的步數。

ex.en: The tracker followed the animal's footprints through the forest.
ex.zh: 追蹤者循著動物的腳印穿過森林。

ex.en: A good tracker can tell how long ago a deer passed.
ex.zh: 優秀的追蹤者能判斷鹿是多久前經過的。

ex.en: He went to the basketball tryout after school.
ex.zh: 他放學後去參加籃球隊的選拔。

ex.en: The tryouts for the school play start on Monday.
ex.zh: 學校話劇的甄選從星期一開始。

ex.en: The three countries signed a tripartite agreement.
ex.zh: 三個國家簽署了三方協議。

ex.en: The report has a tripartite structure: problem, cause, and solution.
ex.zh: 這份報告分為三部分：問題、原因和解決辦法。

trying.zh: 嘗試；努力（try 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I am trying to learn how to cook a few simple dishes.
ex.zh: 我正在試著學做幾道簡單的菜。

ex.en: Stop trying to fix everything by yourself.
ex.zh: 別再試著一個人解決所有事情了。

ex.en: It has been a trying week for the whole family.
ex.zh: 對全家人來說，這是難熬的一週。

ex.en: Waiting for the test results was a trying experience.
ex.zh: 等待檢查結果是一段煎熬的經驗。

ex.en: The old attic turned out to be a trove of family photos.
ex.zh: 那間老閣樓原來是個裝滿家庭照片的寶庫。

ex.en: Divers found a trove of coins in the shipwreck.
ex.zh: 潛水員在沉船裡發現了一批硬幣寶藏。

ex.en: He described the sunrise as a transcendental experience.
ex.zh: 他形容日出是一次超凡的體驗。

ex.en: Pi is a transcendental number that never ends.
ex.zh: 圓周率是個永遠沒有盡頭的超越數。

ex.en: A sign warned that trespassers would be reported to the police.
ex.zh: 告示牌警告擅自闖入者將被報警處理。

ex.en: The farmer caught a trespasser walking across his field.
ex.zh: 農夫逮到一名擅自穿越他田地的人。

ex.en: A truckload of fresh vegetables arrives every morning.
ex.zh: 每天早上都有一整卡車的新鮮蔬菜送到。

ex.en: We hauled a truckload of sand to the building site.
ex.zh: 我們運了一整車的沙子到工地。

ex.en: A microphone is a transducer that turns sound into electricity.
ex.zh: 麥克風是把聲音轉換成電訊號的換能器。

ex.en: The engineer replaced the faulty pressure transducer.
ex.zh: 工程師更換了故障的壓力換能器。

ex.en: This old watch is my most treasured possession.
ex.zh: 這支舊錶是我最珍愛的東西。

ex.en: She kept the treasured letters in a small box.
ex.zh: 她把珍貴的信件收在一個小盒子裡。

ex.en: He treasured every moment with his grandfather.
ex.zh: 他珍惜與祖父相處的每一刻。

ex.en: They treasured the photos from their trip.
ex.zh: 他們很珍視那趟旅行的照片。

ex.en: Roses climbed up the wooden trellis by the door.
ex.zh: 玫瑰沿著門邊的木製棚架向上攀爬。

ex.en: He built a trellis for the beans to grow on.
ex.zh: 他搭了一個棚架讓豆子攀爬生長。

ex.en: The bridge has a transverse beam for extra support.
ex.zh: 這座橋有一根橫樑提供額外支撐。

ex.en: The doctor looked at a transverse section of the bone.
ex.zh: 醫生查看了骨頭的橫切面。

ex.en: The family faced years of tribulation after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，這個家庭歷經了多年的苦難。

ex.en: She spoke about the trials and tribulations of raising children.
ex.zh: 她談到養育孩子的種種考驗與磨難。

ex.en: Trotsky was a leader of the Russian Revolution.
ex.zh: 托洛斯基是俄國革命的領袖之一。

ex.en: The history class read about Trotsky and the Soviet Union.
ex.zh: 歷史課讀到了托洛斯基與蘇聯的相關內容。

ex.en: Don't trivialize her worries; they are real to her.
ex.zh: 不要把她的煩惱說得微不足道，對她而言那是真實的。

ex.en: The film trivializes a serious historical event.
ex.zh: 這部電影把一個嚴肅的歷史事件拍得太輕描淡寫。

ex.en: A large transporter carried the new cars to the dealer.
ex.zh: 一輛大型運輸車把新車運到經銷商那裡。

ex.en: The company is a major transporter of fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 那家公司是新鮮水果的主要運輸業者。

ex.en: The school is working to reduce truancy among students.
ex.zh: 學校正努力減少學生曠課的情形。

ex.en: His truancy worried his parents.
ex.zh: 他的曠課讓父母很擔心。

ex.en: After years of travail, the family finally built their own house.
ex.zh: 歷經多年的辛勞，這家人終於蓋好了自己的房子。

ex.en: The book describes the travail of the early settlers.
ex.zh: 這本書描述了早期移民的艱辛。

ex.en: The boats trawl for shrimp off the coast.
ex.zh: 那些船在海岸外用拖網捕蝦。

ex.en: Fishermen trawled the deep water all night.
ex.zh: 漁夫整晚在深水區用拖網捕魚。

ex.en: The crew pulled the heavy trawl onto the deck.
ex.zh: 船員把沉重的拖網拉上甲板。

ex.en: A trawl can catch thousands of fish at once.
ex.zh: 一張拖網可以一次捕到上千條魚。

ex.en: Light came in through the transom above the door.
ex.zh: 光線從門上方的氣窗照了進來。

ex.en: The old house has a small glass transom over each bedroom door.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子每間臥室的門上方都有一扇小玻璃氣窗。

ex.en: The old tale is about a clever trickster who fools a king.
ex.zh: 這則古老的故事講的是一個騙過國王的機靈騙子。

ex.en: My little brother is a real trickster who loves playing jokes.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是個愛惡作劇的搗蛋鬼。

ex.en: She keeps a few trinkets from her travels on the shelf.
ex.zh: 她把幾件旅行帶回來的小飾品放在架上。

ex.en: The shop sells cheap trinkets for tourists.
ex.zh: 這家店賣給觀光客的便宜小玩意兒。

ex.en: She felt very tired during the first trimester of her pregnancy.
ex.zh: 她在懷孕的第一孕期感到非常疲倦。

ex.en: The doctor explained what happens in each trimester.
ex.zh: 醫生說明了每個孕期會發生的事。

ex.en: Our school divides the year into three trimesters.
ex.zh: 我們學校把一學年分成三個學期。

ex.en: I have four classes this trimester.
ex.zh: 這學期我有四門課。

ex.en: The tribesman showed us how to build a fire in the forest.
ex.zh: 那位部落男子示範了如何在森林裡生火。

ex.en: Each tribesman wore a necklace made of shells.
ex.zh: 每位部落男子都戴著貝殼做的項鍊。

ex.en: The trial was a travesty of justice.
ex.zh: 那場審判是對正義的嘲弄。

ex.en: The movie is a travesty of the original book.
ex.zh: 這部電影把原著糟蹋得面目全非。

ex.en: She trained for months to finish her first triathlon.
ex.zh: 她訓練了好幾個月，只為完成第一場鐵人三項。

ex.en: A triathlon includes swimming, cycling, and running.
ex.zh: 鐵人三項包括游泳、自行車和跑步。

ex.en: The trawler returned to port with a full catch.
ex.zh: 那艘拖網漁船滿載漁獲返回港口。

ex.en: A small trawler sailed out before sunrise.
ex.zh: 一艘小型拖網漁船在日出前出海。

ex.en: The tracer helped them follow the package.
ex.zh: 這個追蹤器幫助他們追蹤包裹。

ex.en: Tracer bullets glow so soldiers can see where they go.
ex.zh: 曳光彈會發光，讓士兵看見它的軌跡。

ex.en: He works in the trucking industry and drives long distances.
ex.zh: 他在貨運業工作，經常長途開車。

ex.en: Rising fuel prices have hurt trucking companies.
ex.zh: 燃油價格上漲對貨運公司造成了打擊。

ex.en: Fame can be transitory, so enjoy it while it lasts.
ex.zh: 名氣可能很短暫，所以趁還在時好好享受。

ex.en: The pain was transitory and disappeared within an hour.
ex.zh: 那陣疼痛是暫時的，一個小時內就消失了。

ex.en: He fixed the fence with his trusty hammer.
ex.zh: 他用那把可靠的老榔頭修好了籬笆。

ex.en: My trusty old car never lets me down.
ex.zh: 我那輛可靠的老車從沒讓我失望過。

ex.en: The disease is treatable if found early.
ex.zh: 這種病如果及早發現是可以治療的。

ex.en: Most cases of the infection are easily treatable.
ex.zh: 這種感染大多數病例都很容易治療。

ex.en: Anyone who transgresses the rules will be punished.
ex.zh: 違反規則的人都會受罰。

ex.en: The speech transgressed the limits of polite behavior.
ex.zh: 那番話已越過了禮貌的界線。

ex.en: She dug a small hole with a garden trowel and planted the flower.
ex.zh: 她用園藝小鏟挖了個小洞，把花種進去。

ex.en: The builder smoothed the wet cement with a trowel.
ex.zh: 工人用泥刀把濕水泥抹平。

ex.en: A single golden tress fell across her shoulder.
ex.zh: 一綹金色的髮絲垂落在她的肩上。

ex.en: The poem praised the long dark tresses of the princess.
ex.zh: 這首詩讚美公主那一頭長長的黑髮。

ex.en: They argued over a trifling amount of money.
ex.zh: 他們為了一筆微不足道的錢爭吵。

ex.en: It's a trifling matter, so don't worry about it.
ex.zh: 這只是件小事，不用擔心。

ex.en: She was upset by such a trifling mistake.
ex.zh: 她為這麼一個小錯誤而心煩。

ex.en: The trumpeter played a lively tune at the festival.
ex.zh: 小號手在慶典上吹奏了一首輕快的曲子。

ex.en: He wants to become a jazz trumpeter someday.
ex.zh: 他希望有一天成為爵士小號手。

ex.en: The children enjoyed tracing the shapes onto thin paper.
ex.zh: 孩子們喜歡把圖形描在薄紙上。

ex.en: Tracing the source of the leak took all morning.
ex.zh: 追查漏水的源頭花了一整個早上。

truism.zh: 老生常談；不言而喻的道理

ex.en: It's a truism that practice makes perfect.
ex.zh: 熟能生巧是老生常談了。

ex.en: He ended the speech with a tired truism about hard work.
ex.zh: 他以一句陳腔濫調的努力論結束了演講。

ex.en: Push-ups work your chest and your triceps.
ex.zh: 伏地挺身能訓練胸肌和三頭肌。

ex.en: He strained his triceps while lifting weights.
ex.zh: 他舉重時拉傷了三頭肌。

ex.en: The cook trussed the chicken with string before roasting it.
ex.zh: 廚師在烤雞之前用棉線把雞綁好。

ex.en: They trussed the boxes tightly so nothing would fall off the truck.
ex.zh: 他們把箱子綁緊，免得東西從卡車上掉下來。

truss.zh: 桁架（支撐屋頂或橋樑的框架）

ex.en: The roof is held up by a wooden truss.
ex.zh: 屋頂由木製桁架支撐著。

ex.en: Engineers checked every steel truss on the old bridge.
ex.zh: 工程師檢查了舊橋上的每一根鋼桁架。

ex.en: The movie's ending was trite and easy to guess.
ex.zh: 這部電影的結局老套，很容易猜到。

ex.en: It may sound trite, but honesty really is the best policy.
ex.zh: 這聽起來也許老套，但誠實真的是上策。

ex.en: Everyone admired her truthfulness during the interview.
ex.zh: 大家都欣賞她在訪談中的誠實。

ex.en: The judge questioned the truthfulness of his statement.
ex.zh: 法官質疑他陳述的真實性。

ex.en: They set a board across two trestles to make a table.
ex.zh: 他們把木板架在兩個支架上當桌子。

ex.en: The old train crossed the valley on a wooden trestle.
ex.zh: 老火車從木造棧橋上穿越山谷。

transferred.zh: 轉移；調動；轉學（transfer 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: She transferred to a new school last year.
ex.zh: 她去年轉到了一所新學校。

ex.en: He transferred the money to my account this morning.
ex.zh: 他今天早上把錢轉到我的帳戶。

ex.en: The company transferred him to the Tainan office.
ex.zh: 公司把他調到台南辦公室。

ex.en: He plays the trombone in the school band.
ex.zh: 他在學校樂隊吹長號。

ex.en: The trombone has a long slide that changes the notes.
ex.zh: 長號有一根長長的伸縮管可以改變音高。

ex.en: The nurse performed triage to decide who needed help first.
ex.zh: 護理師進行檢傷分類，決定誰該先接受治療。

ex.en: Patients wait at the triage desk before seeing a doctor.
ex.zh: 病患在看醫生之前，要先在檢傷分類櫃檯等候。

ex.en: The kids jumped on the trampoline in the backyard all afternoon.
ex.zh: 孩子們整個下午都在後院的彈跳床上跳。

ex.en: He fell off the trampoline but wasn't hurt.
ex.zh: 他從彈跳床上摔下來，但沒有受傷。

ex.en: You can transact most banking business online now.
ex.zh: 現在大多數銀行業務都能在網路上辦理。

ex.en: The two firms transacted a deal worth millions.
ex.zh: 那兩家公司完成了一筆價值數百萬的交易。

ex.en: The transference of power took place peacefully.
ex.zh: 權力的轉移和平地完成。

ex.en: The contract allows the transference of the license to another person.
ex.zh: 這份合約允許把執照轉讓給他人。

ex.en: The truncated version of the film is only an hour long.
ex.zh: 這部電影的刪減版只有一個小時。

ex.en: He read a truncated report because there was no time.
ex.zh: 因為沒時間，他讀的是縮短版的報告。

ex.en: The thieves got in through trickery, not force.
ex.zh: 小偷靠詭計而非蠻力進入。

ex.en: The magician's act depends on clever trickery.
ex.zh: 魔術師的表演靠的是巧妙的把戲。

ex.en: We traipsed through the mud for an hour.
ex.zh: 我們在泥濘中拖著腳步走了一個小時。

ex.en: I don't want to traipse around the mall all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我不想整個下午在購物中心裡晃來晃去。

ex.en: Old alchemists hoped to transmute lead into gold.
ex.zh: 古代煉金術士希望把鉛變成黃金。

ex.en: She tried to transmute her sadness into art.
ex.zh: 她試著把悲傷轉化為藝術。
